caption: The drawing depicts a single metal candle holder positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The candle holder is comprised of a broad, rectangular, wooden base colored in various brown hues with visible wood grain texture. Attached to this base, the metal structure of the holder is rendered in a deep brown, suggesting wrought iron or a similar metal, and is formed from two curved vertical rods that rise symmetrically and join at the top with a cup-shaped candle socket. The vertical rods each form inward-facing scrolls or spirals, both at the midsection and base, creating a decorative effect. On one side, a small leaf-shaped detail branches off from one of the scrolls. The overall composition is centered, with the object occupying the middle of the image and significant empty space surrounding it.
title: Candlesticks
